title: SAP Recognized as a Leader in the 2026 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Cloud ERP for Service-Centric Enterprises
summary: SAP is a Leader in the 2026 Gartner Magic Quadrant for Cloud ERP for Service-Centric Enterprises, marking five consecutive years.
body_markdown:
We are pleased to announce that SAP has been named a Leader in the 2026 Gartner Magic Quadrant for Cloud ERP for Service-Centric Enterprises for the fifth year in a row.


SAP has been a Leader in this Magic Quadrant every year since its inception in 2022.


We believe this recognition, based on our Completeness of Vision and Ability to Execute, reflects our commitment to helping service-centric enterprises—from midmarket to the most complex global organizations—run smarter with integrated, AI-enabled cloud ERP.


At SAP, this is what our Autonomous Enterprise strategy is designed to deliver.


This graphic was published by Gartner, Inc. as part of a larger research document and should be evaluated in the context of the entire document. The Gartner document is available[here](https://www.sap.com/products/erp/grow.html?url_id=gartner-mq-2026-cloud-erp-service-centric&rc=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.gartner.com%2Freprints%2F%3Fid%3D00ThR00000TAiyOUAT%26ct%3D261105%26st%3Dsb) .


A services firm’s hardest problems are knowing engagement margin while the work is still under way, billing every hour, and closing the books across dozens of entities and countries. SAP Cloud ERP runs the engagement on one record from contract through staffing, time and expense, revenue recognition and client billing, so margin is visible during delivery and the close does not wait for reconciliation. SAP Project and Resource Management staffs engagements against skills and availability, and SAP Subscription Billing supports the recurring and outcome-based models clients increasingly ask for. Nineteen of the top 20 professional services firms run SAP, across consulting, audit and tax, IT and BPO services, engineering, legal, business services, and staffing.


Our AI works the same way. Joule Assistants coordinate role-aware agents across the service life cycle, grounded in the SAP Knowledge Graph and executing inside the transaction with approvals and audit trails built in.


For example, among the many agentic experiences we’re making available, the Project Management Assistant sets up an engagement from similar past projects, monitors planned against actual effort while the work is underway, and simulates the margin impact of a change before it is committed: 30% less time on resource allocation and 16% less rework from projects set up on the wrong template.


The Billing Assistant catches abnormal charges and tax calculations before an invoice goes out, resolves posting errors in plain language, and cancels and recreates an invoice when a dispute requires it: 90% less time to resolve billing posting issues and 70% less invoice reprocessing effort. In accounting, the Accounting Accruals Agent and Receivables and Payables Clearing Agent are generally available and post directly against the Universal Journal.


For us, recognition as a Leader is a milestone, not the end of the journey. Customers tell us they want AI that works across a landscape that is never only SAP, predictable cost as automation scales, and SAP Cloud ERP at the scale of their largest operations. We are acting on that:


- **One architecture across the landscape:** Agents coordinate work across cloud ERP and the rest of the suite on shared data models and process semantics, third-party agents connect through open protocols—Agent2Agent and Model Context Protocol—via agent gateway rather than direct database access, and SAP AI Agent Hub, now generally available, discovers and governs every agent, SAP or not, before it reaches production.
- **Simpler commercial terms:** Joule Assistants and migration tooling are included in RISE with SAP and SAP GROW, SAP Build is included in SAP Business Suite packages, and AI consumption is metered in one unit.
- **Enterprise scale:** SAP Cloud ERP is localized for 69 countries in 34 languages, SAP operates and upgrades it, and customers run it as a single instance with tens of thousands of users and 40 countries live from one go-live.


Looking ahead, we remain focused on what has always mattered most to our customers: a cloud ERP foundation that delivers faster time to value, AI that operates with the trust and governance businesses require, and the flexibility to scale from the midmarket to the most complex global organizations. We feel that this Gartner recognition validates the progress we’ve made.
